M1 names the Mac's entries: measure-0093.sh in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/wt-0093 (clean, detached at 910af45, its own target): cargo test --release --workspace --no-run, then the same tests with TMPDIR an empty dir of the run's own (~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/t93-<label>), each entry left listed by name and grouped by helper. No edits, no GUI, daemon or port. Size S. dc's kovacs naming on 910af45 asked of dc beside it. The design follows from both lists.
